visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with fair skin, long black hair, and red heart-shaped hairpins sits in a brightly lit room. She holds a thick stack of folded knit sweaters in colors like oatmeal, brown, and charcoal gray. Her face shows a bright smile, and her hands are wrapped around the textiles. The background is a white wall with minimalist shelving containing small decorative items. (2) The scene cuts to her wearing a vibrant red cardigan with prominent gold buttons and a round neckline. She stands with her hands on her hips, showing a black pleated mini-skirt. The lighting is warm and even, highlighting the texture of the knitwear. She points to the gold buttons with her index fingers. (3) She puts on a tan utility-style vest with a belt over the red cardigan, then adds a longer tan trench coat. She turns 360 degrees to display the silhouette. Her hands adjust the lapels of the coat. The setting remains the same bright indoor room with a white door visible in the background. (4) The host switches to a mocha-colored knit dress with a wide white pointed collar. She touches the fabric near her neck, eyes smiling at the camera. The scene transitions to her layering a white puffer vest over the dress. She cinches the vest and poses with her hands in the pockets. (5) Finally, she wears a long, oversized gray wool coat. She ties the waist belt securely and presents herself from the side and front. She waves one hand towards the camera with a playful expression. The room lighting remains soft and natural throughout the sequence.
